scope_note: Two-part epoxy-amine thermoset. Epoxy: Resoltech 1070 ECO (DGEBA-based epoxy with a partially bio-based reactive diluent). Hardener: Resoltech 1074 ECO, active species 3-aminomethyl-3,5,5-trimethylcyclohexylamine (isophorone diamine, IPDA; a cycloaliphatic diamine). Directly in-scope for marine anti-corrosion two-part epoxy-amine cure/pot-life physics.

rights.attribution: Lascano D., Quiles-Carrillo L., Balart R., Boronat T., Montanes N. Kinetic Analysis of the Curing of a Partially Biobased Epoxy Resin Using Dynamic Differential Scanning Calorimetry. Polymers (Basel). 2019;11(3):391.

measurement.source_table: Table 3 (peak cure temperature and total reaction enthalpy vs heating rate)

raw_inputs.description: ONLY these (heating_rate, peak_temperature) pairs feed the Kissinger recomputation. reaction_enthalpy is carried for provenance and is NOT used by the estimator.

reference_outputs.note: Activation energies reported by the paper. Used ONLY as validation targets, never as inputs to the recomputation, so recovering Kissinger Ea from the raw peaks is a genuine method-fidelity test, not a tautology.
